Drawer background isolation and keyboard focus return
Checkout remains usable after browser Back
Wishlist retrieval, removal, empty recovery and mobile layout
Storefront reset preserves Admin state; empty cart recovery
No-JavaScript forms cannot submit personal data through a URL
Blocked browser storage has an honest cart recovery message
Touch-context menu, Home FAQ, catalogue filtering/no-match/reset, frame selection, lightbox, PIN check, add-to-cart and sample checkout.
All registered Admin screens at 360, 390, 768 and 1440 px; no document overflow, missing records or JS/network errors.
Phone: complete payment-to-delivery journey, mismatch blocking, duplicate payment, one booking after timeout, handover before dispatch, stale delivery event, four messages and refresh persistence.
Retained order filters, no-match recovery and global provider-reference search open original records.
All 23 AF1 story loaders restore a fresh scenario, including Operations direct-finance denial.
Failed inspection cannot pass without recorded correction; history survives recheck. Partial refund approval, unknown submission and confirmed recovery work.
Identity-gated manual support response, CSV row errors/drafts, incomplete-publication block and synthetic two-factor session journey.
Keyboard: skip link preserves route and focuses content; closed phone navigation is inert, opening moves focus, Escape restores it and desktop resize restores navigation access.
A pre-purchase enquiry creates a separate contact and owned case without inventing an order; original profile/case links open correctly.
Confirmed refund value is credited once; return inspection requires actual receipt and old events cannot erase the four-event movement/evidence history.
An all-draft reply library has an actionable approval state; changing order filters in a stale tab cannot overwrite newer work.
No business/provider requests, no public storage changes; sample state only.
modelGuards: Authorisation cannot release work; captured duplicates produce one confirmation.
Last-frame competition keeps the existing reservation and retains the late paid order.
Hold blocks production; a stale cancellation cannot erase actual printing or consumed materials.
Competing refunds cannot exceed balance; editing invalidates approval and unknown submissions remain reserved.
Uncertain booking is recovered once; handover gates dispatch and old tracking cannot regress delivery; split order remains partial.
Failed mutations restore state and keep dialog record references valid for correction.
Another tab’s newer state blocks a stale consequential edit.
Filter/session saves also cannot overwrite a newer tab; explicit scenario reset can replace sample state.
A one-item remedy cannot refund the value of two purchased units.
A stock correction after reservation cannot start printing or consume negative stock.
Later refunds invalidate the current bank comparison but retain receipt evidence; unknown fees keep expected settlement unknown.
Resolving one request leaves other cases on the same order open; reopening restores a correctly owned follow-up.
CSV exports neutralise formula-like cells and quote embedded quotes.
